name: Leaning Tower of Pisa
note: The bell tower of Pisa Cathedral.

name: Big Ben (Elizabeth Tower)
note: The item is the clock tower of the Palace of Westminster, which the bell gives its common name.

name: Minaret of Jam
note: Remote and rarely reachable; famous as a tower all the same.

name: Qutb Minar
note: The minaret itself, not the Qutb complex (Q1074330) it stands in.

name: Belém Tower
note: A fortified tower on the Tagus; not a lighthouse or a gate.

name: Giralda
note: Bell tower of Seville Cathedral, built as the Almohad minaret; climbed by its ramps.

name: Kuala Lumpur Tower
note: A telecommunications and observation tower (Menara KL), visited for its decks; not the Petronas Towers.

name: Koutoubia Minaret
note: Wikidata has no item for the minaret apart from the mosque; the mosque item stands for it. The tower is looked at, not climbed (closed to non-Muslims).

name: Giant Wild Goose Pagoda
note: The pagoda of Da Ci'en Temple, climbed; the temple is not the entry.

name: Hassan Tower
note: The unfinished minaret in Rabat (the item is the tower, though its English description says mosque).

name: Kalyan Minaret
note: The second source is a partial selection (a travel agency page on the minarets of Uzbekistan that singles it out as the symbol of Bukhara).

name: N Seoul Tower
note: The World Federation of Great Towers lists it as YTN Seoul Tower.

name: The STRAT SkyPod (Stratosphere Tower)
note: Wikidata has one item for the hotel, casino and tower together; no item for the tower alone. Visited as a tower.

name: Shukhov Tower
note: The Shabolovka radio tower in Moscow, not the other Shukhov towers. Looked at, not climbed.

name: Rundetaarn
note: Climbed by its spiral ramp.

name: Giotto's Campanile
note: The bell tower of Florence Cathedral, climbed.

name: Söyembikä Tower
note: Not on the own list. The leaning tower of the Kazan Kremlin, looked at.

name: Yellow Crane Tower
note: A rebuilt pavilion tower climbed for the view over the Yangtze.

name: Blackpool Tower
note: Not on the own list; named by two sources.

name: Skylon Tower
note: Not on the own list; named by two sources.

name: Torre Latinoamericana
note: Wikidata types it an office skyscraper; it stays because its sources name it for its observation deck, the Mirador Torre Latino, which the World Federation of Great Towers lists, and it shows the class such a deck carries.

name: Songyue Pagoda
note: Not on the own list. The oldest brick pagoda in China; looked at, not climbed.

name: Six Harmonies Pagoda (Liuhe Pagoda)
note: Climbed for the view over the Qiantang River.

name: Fernsehturm Stuttgart
note: The first concrete TV tower, the model of the kind.

name: Leifeng Pagoda
note: Rebuilt in 2002 over the ruins of the old pagoda; climbed for the view over West Lake.

name: Torre del Mangia
note: The tower of the Palazzo Pubblico, Siena; climbed on its own ticket.

name: Pagoda of Fogong Temple (Yingxian Wooden Pagoda)
note: Looked at; the upper floors are closed to visitors.

name: Kalta Minor
note: Not on the compiler's own list. The unfinished, tiled minaret of Khiva, visited to look at; one of its two sources is a travel agency's page of Uzbekistan's minarets.

name: Torrazzo of Cremona
note: Not on the own list. The bell tower of Cremona Cathedral, climbed.

name: Torre dei Lamberti
note: The civic tower of Verona, climbed.

name: Three Pagodas of Chongsheng Temple
note: Not on the own list. One ensemble of three pagodas seen together. Two selections name the ensemble; a third names its central Qianxun Pagoda, which has no item of its own.

name: Leaning Tower of Nevyansk
note: Not on the own list. A leaning tower, climbed as part of its museum.

name: Malwiya Minaret
note: The spiral minaret of the Great Mosque of Samarra (Q593115), not the mosque.

name: Asinelli Tower
note: Touropia names the pair as the Two Towers of Bologna; the group item (Q1784259) is not used.

name: Dom Tower of Utrecht
note: A cathedral tower standing apart from its church, climbed.

name: Garisenda Tower
note: Not on the own list; named by four sources beside the Asinelli. Looked at, not climbed (closed for its lean).

name: Montreal Tower
note: Not on the own list. The inclined mast of the Olympic Stadium, visited for its observatory; office floors inside do not make it a skyscraper.

name: Bell tower of Curon (Lake Reschen)
note: Not on the own list. The bell tower of a church drowned by a reservoir, looked at from the shore or the ice.

name: Five-storied Pagoda of Daigo-ji
note: Not on the own list. One of the three great pagodas of Japan; the pagoda, not the temple.

name: Five-storied Pagoda of Hōryū-ji
note: The pagoda, not the temple; looked at, not climbed, like every Japanese pagoda.

name: Five-storied Pagoda of Rurikō-ji
note: Not on the own list. One of the three great pagodas of Japan; the pagoda, not the temple (Q11573988).
